questions.question_hindi: विद्यांजलि कार्यक्रम दिशानिर्देशों के अंतर्गत संस्थागत उत्तरदायित्वों और अस्वीकरण (Disclaimer) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
options_hindi: गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित करना और स्वयंसेवकों का सत्यापन — प्रयोक्ता एजेंसी / स्कूल
स्वयंसेवक/योगदानकर्ता की उपयुक्तता का आकलन — स्कूल प्राधिकरण
स्वयंसेवक के आचरण और सेवा गुणवत्ता का कानूनी दायित्व — शिक्षा मंत्रालय और NIC
पोर्टल डिजाइन और तकनीकी विकास — शिक्षा मंत्रालय और राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान केंद्र (NIC)
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs regarding institutional responsibilities and disclaimers under the Vidyanjali program guidelines is NOT correctly matched?
options_english: Ascertaining quality and verification of volunteers — User agency / School
Assessing suitability of volunteer/contributor — School authorities
Legal liability for volunteer conduct and service quality — Ministry of Education and NIC
Portal design and technical development — Ministry of Education and National Informatics Centre (NIC)
questions.explanation_english: The disclaimer clearly specifies that MoE and NIC are NOT responsible for conduct, service quality, or any other issues with respect to the contribution. The user agency/school is entirely responsible for volunteer verification, conduct, and quality assurance.
questions.explanation_hindi: अस्वीकरण में स्पष्ट किया गया है कि शिक्षा मंत्रालय और एनआईसी योगदान के संबंध में आचरण, सेवा की गुणवत्ता या किसी अन्य मुद्दे के लिए जिम्मेदार नहीं हैं। स्वयंसेवक सत्यापन, आचरण और गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित करने की पूरी जिम्मेदारी प्रयोक्ता एजेंसी/स्कूल की है।
key_facts: MoE/NIC is not responsible for conduct/service quality/any other issues with respect to the contribution. User agency/School shall be responsible for proper verification of volunteers, volunteer conduct, ascertaining the quality and all other aspects of contribution.

questions.question_hindi:
पुनर्गठित विद्यांजलि पोर्टल के तहत संस्थागत दायरे और मूल्यांकन तंत्र के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. यह पोर्टल समुदाय और स्वयंसेवकों को अपनी पसंद के सरकारी और सरकारी सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों से सीधे जुड़ने की अनुमति देता है।
2. किसी स्वयंसेवक द्वारा रुचि व्यक्त किए जाने पर, स्कूल प्राधिकरण स्वयंसेवक की उपयुक्तता और योगदान की गई संपत्ति/उपकरण के विनिर्देशों का आकलन करते हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutional scope and assessment mechanism under the revamped Vidyanjali portal:

1. The portal allows community and volunteers to connect directly with Government and Government aided schools of their choice.
2. Upon an expression of interest by a volunteer, the school authorities assess the suitability of the volunteer and the specifications of contributed assets/equipment.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. According to Section 1.1 of the Vidyanjali guidelines, the portal enables volunteers to connect directly with Government and Government-aided schools of their choice, and the school authorities assess the suitability of the volunteer and asset specifications.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। विद्यांजलि दिशानिर्देशों के खंड 1.1 के अनुसार, पोर्टल स्वयंसेवकों को अपनी पसंद के सरकारी और सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों से सीधे जुड़ने में सक्षम बनाता है, और स्कूल प्राधिकरण स्वयंसेवक की उपयुक्तता तथा परिसंपत्ति विनिर्देशों का आकलन करते हैं।
key_facts: The newlyintroduced portal -Vidyanjali –will help thecommunity/volunteers interact and connect directly with Government and Government aided schools of their choice to share their knowledge and skills as well as contribute in the form of assets/material/equipment. Upon the expression of interest by a volunteer/contributor, the school authorities will assess the suitability of the volunteer/contributor for the service/activity and/or the specifications of the assets/material/equipmentin accordance with the procedure as set out in these guidelines.

questions.question_hindi:
विद्यांजलि दिशानिर्देशों में NEP 2020 के प्रावधानों के अंतर्गत उल्लिखित स्वयंसेवी सहभागिता और प्रौढ़ साक्षरता मॉडलों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. विभिन्न कार्यक्रमों के तहत प्रौद्योगिकी और सामुदायिक पहुंच के व्यापक उपयोग द्वारा छात्रों और स्वयंसेवकों के बीच बातचीत को गति दी जा सकती है (NEP पैरा 3.6 और 3.7)।
2. क्षेत्रीय अध्ययन दर्शाते हैं कि राजनीतिक इच्छाशक्ति, उचित योजना और क्षमता निर्माण के साथ-साथ स्वयंसेवा और सामुदायिक लामबंदी प्रौढ़ साक्षरता कार्यक्रमों की सफलता के प्रमुख कारक हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding volunteer engagement and adult literacy models highlighted under NEP 2020 provisions in the Vidyanjali guidelines:

1. Interaction between students and volunteers can be catalyzed by extensive use of technology and community outreach under various programs (NEP Para 3.6 & 3.7).
2. Field studies indicate that volunteerism and community mobilization are key success factors of adult literacy programmes, alongside political will, proper planning, and capacity building.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. Section 1.2 of the guidelines reiterates NEP Para 3.6 & 3.7 regarding catalyzing student-volunteer interaction through technology and outreach, and notes that field studies prove volunteerism and community mobilization are essential to the success of adult literacy programs.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। दिशानिर्देशों का खंड 1.2 एनईपी पैरा 3.6 और 3.7 को दोहराता है कि प्रौद्योगिकी और आउटरीच के माध्यम से छात्र-स्वयंसेवक बातचीत को बढ़ावा दिया जा सकता है, तथा यह रेखांकित करता है कि क्षेत्रीय अध्ययन सिद्ध करते हैं कि स्वयंसेवा और सामुदायिक लामबंदी प्रौढ़ साक्षरता कार्यक्रमों की सफलता के प्रमुख कारक हैं।
key_facts: To provide ease of access, volunteers may be involved under various programs and interaction between students and volunteers could be catalyzed by extensive use of technology and community outreach(NEP Para 3.6 & 3.7);

questions.question_hindi:
विद्यांजलि पहल के तहत दर्ज प्रमुख स्थान-विशिष्ट हस्तक्षेपों और उपलब्धियों के संबंध में सूची I को सूची II से सुमेलित कीजिए:

सूची I (हस्तक्षेप / उपलब्धि)
A. सरकारी स्कूलों में एआई और रोबोटिक्स इनोवेशन लैब की स्थापना
B. डिजिटल कक्षाओं का निर्माण और शिक्षकों का क्षमता निर्माण
C. एनआईसीएसआई (NICSI) द्वारा दिए गए डेस्कटॉप कंप्यूटरों के माध्यम से डिजिटल शिक्षण सहायता
D. बाला (BaLA) पेंटिंग के माध्यम से स्कूल के वातावरण में सुधार

नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर सही उत्तर चुनिए:
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding key location-specific interventions and achievements reported under the Vidyanjali initiative:

List I (Intervention / Achievement)
A. Establishment of AI and Robotics Innovation Labs in Government schools
B. Creation of digital classrooms and capacity building of teachers

questions.explanation_hindi: विद्यांजलि पर आधिकारिक विज्ञप्ति के अनुसार: दिल्ली के सरकारी स्कूलों में एआई और रोबोटिक्स इनोवेशन लैब स्थापित की गईं; धौलपुर, राजस्थान में डिजिटल कक्षाओं का निर्माण और शिक्षकों का क्षमता निर्माण हुआ; बागपत, उत्तर प्रदेश में एनआईसीएसआई द्वारा डेस्कटॉप कंप्यूटर के माध्यम से डिजिटल शिक्षण सहायता प्रदान की गई; तथा बेगूसराय, बिहार में बाला (BaLA) पेंटिंग के माध्यम से सुधार किया गया।
key_facts: Key achievements under Vidyanjali during the period include the establishment of AI and Robotics Innovation Labs in Government schools in Delhi, creation of digital classrooms and capacity building of teachers in Dholpur, Rajasthan, strengthening of digital infrastructure in Mamit, Mizoram, support for digital learning through the contribution of desktop computers to Government schools in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh by NICSI, and improvement of the school environment through BaLA painting in Government schools in Begusarai, Bihar.

questions.question_hindi:
विद्यांजलि पोर्टल पर सत्यापन, सहभागिता रूपरेखा और अनुमोदन पदानुक्रम के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. गैर-सरकारी संगठनों (NGOs) को नीति आयोग द्वारा जारी उनकी एनजीओ दर्पण यूनिक आईडी के माध्यम से विद्यांजलि पोर्टल पर शामिल किया जाता है, जिसे दर्पण पोर्टल के माध्यम से सत्यापित किया जाता है।
2. गैर-सरकारी संगठनों और सीएसआर संगठनों के पंजीकरण को केंद्रीय स्तर पर अनुमोदित किया जाता है, जबकि केंद्रीय सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र उद्यमों (CPSEs) को संबंधित राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश द्वारा अनुमोदित किया जाता है।
3. सीएसआर बल्क एंगेजमेंट फ्रेमवर्क के तहत, सीएसआर संगठन कई स्कूलों में पहचानी गई आवश्यकताओं का समर्थन कर सकते हैं, जबकि 'अडॉप्ट-ए-स्कूल मॉडल' के तहत किसी पहचाने गए स्कूल को उसकी विशिष्ट आवश्यकताओं के आधार पर निरंतर सहायता प्रदान की जाती है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-से सही हैं?
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the verification, engagement frameworks, and approval hierarchy on the Vidyanjali portal:

1. NGOs are onboarded on the Vidyanjali Portal through their NGO DARPAN Unique ID issued by NITI Aayog, which is verified through the DARPAN Portal.
2. Registration of NGOs and CSR organizations is approved at the Central level, whereas Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) are approved by the concerned State/UT.
3. Under the CSR Bulk Engagement framework, CSR organizations can support identified requirements across multiple schools, while under the Adopt-a-School Model, sustained support is provided to an identified school based on its specific requirements.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because the registration of NGOs/CSR organizations is approved by the concerned State/UT, while Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) are approved at the Central level.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 3 सही हैं। कथन 2 गलत है क्योंकि गैर-सरकारी संगठनों/सीएसआर संगठनों के पंजीकरण को संबंधित राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश द्वारा अनुमोदित किया जाता है, जबकि केंद्रीय सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उद्यमों (CPSEs) को केंद्रीय स्तर पर अनुमोदित किया जाता है।
key_facts: NGOs are onboarded on the Vidyanjali Portal through their NGO DARPAN Unique ID issued by NITI Aayog, which is verified through the DARPAN Portal... Under the CSR Bulk Engagement framework, CSR organizations can support identified requirements across multiple schools, while under the Adopt-a-School Model, an organization can provide sustained support to an identified school based on its specific requirements. Registration of NGOs/CSR organizations is approved by the concerned State/UT, while Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) are approved at the Central level.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Vidyanjali portal and school education terminology:

1. The word 'Shagun' associated with the school education portal is coined from two words: 'Shala' meaning Schools and 'Gunvatta' meaning Quality.
2. The Vidyanjali programme is unique in giving freedom to registered volunteers to design their activities in consultation with the school.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. The portal states that 'Shagun' is coined from 'Shala' (meaning Schools) and 'Gunvatta' (meaning Quality). It also highlights that the programme is unique in granting freedom to volunteers to design their activities in consultation with the school.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। पोर्टल बताता है कि 'शगुन' शब्द दो अलग-अलग शब्दों 'शाला' (जिसका अर्थ स्कूल है) और 'गुणवत्ता' (जिसका अर्थ क्वालिटी है) से मिलकर बना है। यह इस बात पर भी प्रकाश डालता है कि यह कार्यक्रम अनूठा है क्योंकि यह स्वयंसेवकों को स्कूल के परामर्श से अपनी गतिविधियों को तैयार करने की स्वतंत्रता देता है।
key_facts: The word 'Shagun' is coined from two different words 'Shala', meaning Schools and 'Gunvatta' meaning Quality... The programme is unique which gives the freedom to the volunteers to design their activities in consultation with the school.

2. इसका उद्देश्य बच्चों को पाठन, रचनात्मक लेखन, सार्वजनिक भाषण, नाटक अभिनय और कहानी की किताबें तैयार करने जैसी गतिविधियों में प्रभावी ढंग से संलग्न करना है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the core mandate, targeted co-scholastic domains, and eligible participant groups under Vidyanjali as per the Department of School Education and Literacy (DSEL), consider the following statements:

1. The Vidyanjali programme is implemented under the overall aegis of Samagra Shiksha.
2. It aims to effectively engage children in activities including reading, creative writing, public speaking, play acting, and preparing story books.
3. To ensure community accountability, volunteer enrollment is exclusively restricted to resident Indian citizens and does not permit persons from the Indian Diaspora.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the programme is open for participation by all Indian citizens including retired professionals, retired government officials, working professionals, homemakers, and also persons from the Indian Diaspora.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1 और 2 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि यह कार्यक्रम सेवानिवृत्त पेशेवरों, सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी अधिकारियों, कामकाजी पेशेवरों, गृहिणियों और भारतीय प्रवासी (Indian Diaspora) के व्यक्तियों सहित सभी भारतीय नागरिकों की भागीदारी के लिए खुला है।
key_facts: Vidyanjali, which is being implemented under the overall aegis of the Samagra Shiksha will enhance the community involvement in Government schools and effectively engage children in reading, creative writing, public speaking, play acting, preparing story books etc. ... The programme will be open for participation by all Indian citizens including retired Professionals, retired government officials, working professionals, homemakers and also persons from the Indian Diaspora.

questions.question_hindi:
विद्यांजलि योजना के संस्थागत विकास और परिचालन संरचना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:

1. इस पहल को सबसे पहले सर्व शिक्षा अभियान के सहयोग से तत्कालीन मानव संसाधन विकास मंत्रालय के तहत प्रायोगिक (पायलट) तौर पर शुरू किया गया था।
2. राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अनुरूप इस कार्यक्रम को सितंबर 2021 में इसके डिजिटल रूप में पर्याप्त रूप से नया स्वरूप देकर पुनः शुरू किया गया था।
3. विद्यांजलि के लिए डिजिटल बुनियादी ढांचे और पोर्टल प्रबंधन को MyGov द्वारा समर्थित किया गया है।
4. विद्यांजलि उच्च शिक्षा स्वयंसेवक कार्यक्रम के माध्यम से AICTE द्वारा इस स्वयंसेवी मॉडल को कॉलेजों और तकनीकी संस्थानों में विस्तारित किया गया है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutional evolution and operational architecture of the Vidyanjali scheme:

1. The initiative was first piloted under the erstwhile Ministry of Human Resource Development in association with the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan.
2. The programme was substantially revamped and relaunched in its digital form in September 2021 in consonance with NEP 2020.
3. The digital infrastructure and portal management for Vidyanjali is supported by MyGov.
4. The volunteer model is extended to colleges and technical institutions through the Vidyanjali Higher Education Volunteer Programme via AICTE.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: All four statements are correct based on the operational assessment of Vidyanjali. It was initially piloted under the erstwhile MHRD with Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and revamped in September 2021. Its digital infrastructure and portal management are supported by MyGov, and the Vidyanjali Higher Education Volunteer Programme extends the model to higher educational and technical institutions through AICTE.
questions.explanation_hindi: विद्यांजलि के परिचालन मूल्यांकन के आधार पर सभी चारों कथन सही हैं। इसे शुरू में तत्कालीन मानव संसाधन विकास मंत्रालय द्वारा सर्व शिक्षा अभियान के साथ प्रायोगिक तौर पर शुरू किया गया था और सितंबर 2021 में नया स्वरूप दिया गया था। इसके डिजिटल बुनियादी ढांचे और पोर्टल प्रबंधन को MyGov द्वारा सहायता प्रदान की जाती है, और विद्यांजलि उच्च शिक्षा स्वयंसेवक कार्यक्रम AICTE के माध्यम से इस मॉडल को उच्च शिक्षण और तकनीकी संस्थानों तक विस्तारित करता है।
key_facts: First piloted under the erstwhile Ministry of Human Resource Development in association with the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, the programme was substantially revamped and relaunched in its current digital form in September 2021, in consonance with the vision of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020... Vidyanjali is implemented by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, with digital infrastructure and portal management supported by MyGov... A parallel vertical, Vidyanjali Higher Education Volunteer Programme, extends the same model to colleges and technical institutions through AICTE.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding key components and structural mechanisms of the Vidyanjali initiative:

List I (Component / Feature)
A. Operational Philosophy
B. Higher Education Extension
C. Digital Portal Tracking Mechanism
D. Primary Target Institutions

List II (Description / Mechanism)
1. Decentralised, demand-driven and needs-first design based on school gaps
2. Extension of volunteer engagement to colleges and technical institutes through AICTE
3. Records volunteer participation, institutional support, activities, assets created, and schools benefited
4. Government and Government-aided schools

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english: Vidyanjali is designed as a demand-driven, decentralised, needs-first mechanism (A-1). Its higher education parallel vertical is implemented through AICTE (B-2). Engagement tracking captures volunteer participation, support extended, activities, assets created, and schools benefited (C-3). The portal directly connects volunteers to Government and Government-aided schools (D-4). Hence, the correct code is A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4.
questions.explanation_hindi: विद्यांजलि को मांग-संचालित, विकेंद्रीकृत और आवश्यकता-प्रथम व्यवस्था के रूप में डिजाइन किया गया है (A-1)। इसका उच्च शिक्षा समानांतर कार्यक्षेत्र AICTE के माध्यम से संचालित होता है (B-2)। सहभागिता ट्रैकिंग द्वारा स्वयंसेवी भागीदारी, दी गई सहायता, गतिविधियों, निर्मित परिसंपत्तियों और लाभान्वित स्कूलों को दर्ज किया जाता है (C-3)। पोर्टल सीधे स्वयंसेवकों को सरकारी और सरकारी सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों से जोड़ता है (D-4)। अतः सही कूट A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4 है।
key_facts: This decentralised, needs-first design where schools articulate specific requirements rather than volunteers being assigned generically is intended to ensure that community contributions are demand-driven and locally relevant... A parallel vertical, Vidyanjali Higher Education Volunteer Programme, extends the same model to colleges and technical institutions through AICTE... Once matched, engagement is tracked through the portal, which records volunteer participation, institutional support extended, activities undertaken, assets created, and the schools benefited... The newly introduced portal -Vidyanjali –will help thecommunity/volunteers interact and connect directly with Government and Government aided schools

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the grounds for terminating engagement with a volunteer under the Vidyanjali guidelines:

1. Found promoting any divisive or other ideologies not conducive for young minds.
2. Harming the safety and security (physical, emotional, social, health-related and cybercrime) of students.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. The scheme guidelines clearly stipulate provisions to terminate engagement with volunteers if they promote divisive or non-conducive ideologies or harm student safety and security across physical, emotional, social, health-related, or cyber aspects.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: According to the decentralized operational workflow of the Vidyanjali portal, how is the engagement process initiated?
options_english: The Central Ministry allocates volunteers directly to schools through an automated lottery system.
Government schools register on the portal and post a list of required services, activities, or material/equipment needs.
State Governments assign CPSEs to conduct commercial infrastructure renovations.
Volunteers directly visit schools without portal onboarding and begin teaching activities.
questions.explanation_english: The operational workflow begins with government schools registering on the Vidyanjali portal and listing their specific requirements for services, activities, or equipment based on student strength and gaps, following a demand-driven approach.

key_facts: The process begins with government schools registering on the portal and posting a list of required services, activities, or material/equipment needs, based on their student strength, existing infrastructure, and resource gaps.

questions.question_english:

1. The initiative operates through a structured digital framework that incorporates approval, monitoring, and feedback mechanisms.

3. Volunteer contributions on the platform are validated directly by the respective schools to promote transparency and accountability.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: According to the official release from the Ministry of Education, all three statements are correct. The initiative operates through a structured digital framework ensuring approval, monitoring and feedback mechanisms. States review progress through dashboards and schools validate volunteer contributions, promoting transparency and accountability.
questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा मंत्रालय के आधिकारिक वक्तव्य के अनुसार, तीनों कथन सही हैं। यह पहल अनुमोदन, निगरानी और फीडबैक तंत्र सुनिश्चित करने वाले एक संरचित डिजिटल ढांचे के माध्यम से संचालित होती है। राज्य डैशबोर्ड के माध्यम से प्रगति की समीक्षा करते हैं और विद्यालय स्वयंसेवकों के योगदान को सत्यापित करते हैं, जिससे पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही को बढ़ावा मिलता है।
key_facts: He further informed that the initiative operates through a structured digital framework ensuring approval, monitoring and feedback mechanisms. States review progress through dashboards and schools validate volunteer contributions, promoting transparency and accountability.

questions.question_english:
Match List I with List II regarding key district-level interventions and achievements reported under the Vidyanjali initiative:

List I (District / State)
A. Dholpur, Rajasthan
B. Mamit, Mizoram
C. Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh
D. Begusarai, Bihar

List II (Intervention under Vidyanjali)
1. Creation of digital classrooms and capacity building of teachers
2. Strengthening of digital infrastructure
3. Contribution of desktop computers to Government schools by NICSI
4. Improvement of school environment through BaLA painting

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation_english: According to the Ministry of Education's official report, key interventions under Vidyanjali include the creation of digital classrooms and capacity building of teachers in Dholpur (Rajasthan), strengthening of digital infrastructure in Mamit (Mizoram), contribution of desktop computers by NICSI in Baghpat (Uttar Pradesh), and improvement of school environments through BaLA painting in Begusarai (Bihar). Thus, A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4 is the correct sequence.
questions.explanation_hindi: शिक्षा मंत्रालय की आधिकारिक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, विद्यांजलि के तहत प्रमुख हस्तक्षेपों में धौलपुर (राजस्थान) में डिजिटल कक्षाओं का निर्माण और शिक्षकों का क्षमता निर्माण, मामित (मिजोरम) में डिजिटल बुनियादी ढांचे का सुदृढ़ीकरण, बागपत (उत्तर प्रदेश) में NICSI द्वारा डेस्कटॉप कंप्यूटरों का योगदान, और बेगूसराय (बिहार) में बाला (BaLA) पेंटिंग के माध्यम से स्कूल परिवेश में सुधार शामिल हैं। अतः A-1, B-2, C-3, D-4 सही क्रम है।
key_facts: Key achievements under Vidyanjali during the period include the establishment of AI and Robotics Innovation Labs in Government schools in Delhi, creation of digital classrooms and capacity building of teachers in Dholpur, Rajasthan, strengthening of digital infrastructure in Mamit, Mizoram, support for digital learning through the contribution of desktop computers to Government schools in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh by NICSI, and improvement of the school environment through BaLA painting in Government schools in Begusarai, Bihar.

1. गैर-सरकारी संगठनों (NGOs) को नीति आयोग द्वारा जारी उनकी एनजीओ दर्पण यूनिक आईडी (NGO DARPAN Unique ID) के माध्यम से पोर्टल पर शामिल किया जाता है, जिसे दर्पण पोर्टल के माध्यम से सत्यापित किया जाता है।
2. कॉर्पोरेट सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व (CSR) संगठनों को सत्यापन के लिए पैन (PAN), जीएसटी पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्र, या उद्यम पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्र जैसे वैध दस्तावेज जमा करना आवश्यक है।
3. गैर-सरकारी संगठनों और केंद्रीय सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र उद्यमों (CPSEs) दोनों के पंजीकरण का अनुमोदन सख्ती से संबंधित राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश प्रशासन में निहित है।

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutional onboarding, verification, and approval frameworks on the Vidyanjali portal:

1. NGOs are onboarded on the portal through their NGO DARPAN Unique ID issued by NITI Aayog, verified through the DARPAN portal.
2. CSR organizations are required to submit valid verification documents such as PAN, GST Registration Certificate, or Udyam Registration Certificate.
3. Registration approval for both NGOs and Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) is strictly vested with the concerned State/UT administration.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because while the registration of NGOs and CSR organizations is approved by the concerned State/UT, Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) are approved at the Central level.

questions.question_english:

A. NEP Para 2.7
B. NEP Para 2.9

1. Peer-tutoring and volunteer activities to support learners in promoting foundational literacy and numeracy
2. Addressing health and nutrition (including mental health) through healthy meals, social workers, counsellors, and community involvement

questions.question_english:

1. The Vidyanjali portal has been designed and developed jointly by the Ministry of Education (MoE) and the National Informatics Centre (NIC).
2. The Ministry of Education and NIC assume direct responsibility for the conduct and service quality rendered by onboarded volunteers.
3. The User agency/School is responsible for proper verification of volunteers, volunteer conduct, and ascertaining the quality of contributions.

questions.explanation_english: According to the Disclaimer of the official Vidyanjali Guidelines: Ministry of Education and NIC designed and developed Vidyanjali. However, MoE/NIC is explicitly NOT responsible for conduct, service quality, or any other issues with respect to the contribution. The User agency/School is responsible for proper verification of volunteers, volunteer conduct, ascertaining the quality, and all other aspects of contribution. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect while statements 1 and 3 are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: आधिकारिक विद्यांजलि दिशानिर्देशों के अस्वीकरण (Disclaimer) के अनुसार: शिक्षा मंत्रालय और NIC ने विद्यांजलि को डिज़ाइन और विकसित किया है। हालाँकि, MoE/NIC योगदान के संबंध में आचरण, सेवा की गुणवत्ता या किसी अन्य मुद्दे के लिए जिम्मेदार नहीं है। स्वयंसेवकों के उचित सत्यापन, स्वयंसेवक के आचरण, गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित करने और योगदान के अन्य सभी पहलुओं के लिए उपयोगकर्ता एजेंसी/विद्यालय जिम्मेदार होगा। अतः कथन 2 गलत है जबकि कथन 1 और 3 सही हैं।
key_facts: Ministry of Education and National Informatics Centre (NIC) has designed and developed Vidyanjali to leverage the contribution/services of community and volunteers in school education. MoE/NIC is not responsible for conduct/service quality/any other issues with respect to the contribution. User agency/School shall be responsible for proper verification of volunteers, volunteer conduct, ascertaining the quality and all other aspects of contribution.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
With reference to the features, volunteer participation, and operational design of the Vidyanjali programme as stated by the Ministry of Education, consider the following statements:

1. The programme is specifically designed to involve volunteers from different walks of life to strengthen co-scholastic activities in government schools.
2. The programme gives volunteers the freedom to design their activities in consultation with the school.
3. Volunteers are required to pay a mandatory nominal onboarding registration fee when registering via the mobile app.
4. The word 'Shagun' is coined from two words: 'Shala', meaning Schools, and 'Gunvatta', meaning Quality.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the portal explicitly specifies: 'The volunteers can register for free by visiting through the mobile app.'
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन 1, 2 और 4 सही हैं। कथन 3 गलत है क्योंकि आधिकारिक विवरण में स्पष्ट कहा गया है कि 'स्वयंसेवक मोबाइल ऐप के माध्यम से निःशुल्क (free) पंजीकरण कर सकते हैं।'
key_facts: The word 'Shagun' is coined from two different words 'Shala', meaning Schools and 'Gunvatta' meaning Quality. The programme is designed to involve volunteers from different walks of life to strengthen the co-scholastic activities in government schools... The volunteers can register for free by visiting through the mobile app. The programme is unique which gives the freedom to the volunteers to design their activities in consultation with the school.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the target volunteer groups and co-scholastic engagement areas under the Vidyanjali initiative:

1. Vidyanjali is open for participation by Indian citizens including retired professionals, retired government officials, working professionals, homemakers, and persons from the Indian Diaspora.
2. The initiative aims to enhance community involvement to engage children in activities such as reading, creative writing, public speaking, play acting, and preparing story books.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Both statements are correct. According to the Ministry of Education, Vidyanjali engages children in reading, creative writing, public speaking, play acting, preparing story books, and is open for participation by all Indian citizens including retired professionals, retired government officials, working professionals, homemakers, and persons from the Indian Diaspora.
questions.explanation_hindi: दोनों कथन सही हैं। शिक्षा मंत्रालय के अनुसार, विद्यांजलि बच्चों को पढ़ने, रचनात्मक लेखन, सार्वजनिक भाषण, नाटक अभिनय, कहानी की किताबें तैयार करने आदि में संलग्न करती है, तथा यह सेवानिवृत्त पेशेवरों, सेवानिवृत्त सरकारी अधिकारियों, कामकाजी पेशेवरों, गृहिणियों और भारतीय प्रवासियों सहित सभी भारतीय नागरिकों के लिए खुली है।
key_facts: Vidyanjali, which is being implemented under the overall aegis of the Samagra Shiksha will enhance the community involvement in Government schools and effectively engage children in reading, creative writing, public speaking, play acting, preparing story books etc... The programme will be open for participation by all Indian citizens including retired Professionals, retired government officials, working professionals, homemakers and also persons from the Indian Diaspora.
